question_text: Linguists have proved that repetition is good for learning a new language. The correct impersonal passive of the sentence above is......

choices.A: it has proved that repetition is good for learning a new language.
choices.B: it had been proved that repetition were good for learning a new language.
choices.C: it has been proved that repetition is good for learning a new language.
choices.D: it had proved that repetition was good for learning a new language.
